advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The trigger sentence already catches them. It fires on any cited file moving other than append-only COORD growth or heading hygiene, and both files are cited in the measured-inputs table, so a move forces re-measurement regardless of the enumeration. The enumeration governs only the narrower PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT path, which requires append-only COORD growth and so cannot be reached by a moving review file. No adoption outcome turns on it.
